heading: Time anomalies
notDeployed: The "Time anomalies" feature becomes available after the backend update. Try again once the deployment is complete.
empty: No anomalies in the selected period.
emptyAllJustified: Nothing left to handle: every anomaly in the period ({{n}}) is already justified. Uncheck "Hide justified" to see them again.

recap.title: Summary
recap.ferieFor: Holiday for {{date}} ({{from}}–{{to}}). Hours are calculated from the assigned schedule.
recap.ferieDayScope: The holiday covers the whole working day: the anomaly you opened the correction from is only the starting point.
recap.permDayScope: Window computed on the whole day of {{date}}: it is the unworked period taken from the "{{kind}}" anomaly — not a figure of the row you opened the correction from (the length of the break, the hours shortfall or the missing stamp).
recap.permSplitDay: This day is unworked at both ends ("{{leading}}" and "{{trailing}}"): the unworked periods are two separate stretches, and one leave cannot cover them without recording the other as worked. Insert them with Correct on the day's two rows, one per stretch. Holiday stays available, because it covers the whole shift.
recap.permSplitShift: Split shift: the window crosses the unpaid gap between the two blocks, which is not charged. Separate leaves are inserted for {{windows}}, and the duration above is their sum.
recap.noBookableWindow: No absence can be inserted on this day. The unworked time left is shorter than the 15 minutes a leave must be a multiple of, and it does not fall on a quarter of an hour: that is why "Add holiday" and "Add leave" are missing from the menu above, on every row of the day.
recap.noBookableWindowFixStamps: Add the missing stamps with "Standard stamping", or close the row with "Justify with a note".
recap.noBookableWindowFixNote: The day's stamps are all there, so there is nothing to complete: close the row with "Justify with a note".
recap.noBookableWindowLeft: Still uncovered: {{windows}}. If this happens on every day of this schedule, check its blocks under Work schedules: a block that does not start and end on a quarter of an hour (e.g. 13:20 or 17:40) leaves those minutes over every day, and no absence can cover them.

noteSection.title: Justification note
noteSection.hint: The anomaly stays on record but annotated; the note appears in exports. With "Hide justified" on it drops out of the list.

bulk.hint: "Justify with a note" and "Standard stamping" are only offered when they are valid for every selected anomaly. Holiday and leave are day-level corrections: they are offered when at least one selected day has unworked time — from any row, break rows included — and the days that cannot take them are skipped, with the count shown above. Holiday, leave and standard stamping are applied once per day; the note stays per single anomaly.
bulk.mergedNotice: You selected {{n}} anomalies across {{days}} days: the correction is applied once per day, otherwise the same absence would be inserted twice.
bulk.skippedNotice_one: 1 selected day cannot take this correction and is skipped: out of {{total}} selected days, {{applied}} are corrected. Correct the skipped day on its own, from its rows, or justify it with a note.
bulk.skippedNotice_other: {{count}} selected days cannot take this correction and are skipped: out of {{total}} selected days, {{applied}} are corrected. Correct the skipped days on their own, from their rows, or justify them with a note.
bulk.ferieConfirm_one: I confirm inserting 1 whole day of holiday: it is deducted from the holiday balance and notified to the employee.
bulk.ferieConfirm_other: I confirm inserting {{count}} whole days of holiday: they are deducted from the holiday balance and notified to the employees concerned.
bulk.permessoPerDay: The leave window is computed for each day from the unworked period of the whole day — the late or missing clock-in, or the early or missing clock-out — whatever the type of the selected rows. To adjust it, use Correct on the single anomaly.
bulk.permessoSplitDays_one: 1 selected day is unworked at both ends (clock-in and clock-out) with worked hours in between: the unworked periods are two separate stretches, and one leave cannot cover them without recording the other as worked — so that day is skipped. Insert the two leaves with Correct on that day's own rows; bulk holiday still covers it, because it applies to the whole shift.
bulk.permessoSplitDays_other: {{count}} selected days are unworked at both ends (clock-in and clock-out) with worked hours in between: the unworked periods are two per day, and one leave cannot cover them without recording the other as worked — so those days are skipped. Insert the leaves with Correct on those days' own rows; bulk holiday still covers them, because it applies to the whole shift.
bulk.permessoSplitShift_one: 1 selected day has a split shift: the window crosses the unpaid gap between the blocks, which is not charged, and that day gets one leave per block instead of a single one.
bulk.permessoSplitShift_other: {{count}} selected days have a split shift: the window crosses the unpaid gap between the blocks, which is not charged, and each day gets one leave per block instead of a single one.
bulk.unbookableDays_one: 1 selected day has unworked time no absence can cover: what is left uncovered is shorter than the 15 minutes a leave must be a multiple of, and it does not fall on a quarter of an hour. Holiday and leave are not applied to it — open Correct on one of its rows to see which minutes are left and which block they come from.
bulk.unbookableDays_other: {{count}} selected days have unworked time no absence can cover: what is left uncovered is shorter than the 15 minutes a leave must be a multiple of, and it does not fall on a quarter of an hour. Holiday and leave are not applied to those days — open Correct on one of their rows to see which minutes are left and which block they come from.
